title: days-view — "what happened" as a dozen finished sentences, not four hundred moments

set.request: our new ai dashboard system still sucks... i never have a nice clean report of what happened. Build a fourth 'days' view on /framework/ai/v/3/ that reads only each task's landing line, newest day first, and make it the default view of /framework/ai/.
set.now: reading page.js, timeline.js and the day/task log shapes
steps: read page.js's view switch and timeline.js, and the day.jsonl / task.jsonl data shapes
decide day.jsonl vs task.jsonl for the row list and write the decision
build the days view: day headings, landed rows folding to full outcome + links, quiet working lines for today
make days the default view, keep ?view= and saved now/grid prefs working
layout pass at 400/1280/1920 and css reuse check
reload hold, headless proof at three widths, screenshot, row-count check for today
set.outcome: **A `days` view on `/framework/ai/v/3/` turns roughly 700 scattered task logs into a short, readable report of what actually happened — and it is now the site's front door.** Newest day first, one row per task that landed that day, collapsed to the one-line headline the task wrote for itself at landing (`day.jsonl`); a click reads that task's own `task.jsonl` once for the full outcome, its links, and a link to the task page. Today's still-running tasks show as one quiet `working — <now>` line each, `<now>` read live the same way a running task's own card already does. `days` is the new default view of both `/framework/ai/v/3/` and `/framework/ai/` (which already renders this page) — `now`/`grid`/`timeline` are one click away exactly as before, `?view=` and a saved preference both still work. Proven headless at 400/1280/1920: zero console errors, no horizontal overflow, a fold opens and loads correctly, and today's row count (8) matches `day.jsonl`'s own landed-line count (8) exactly. ![today's report, opened](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/days-view/shots/days-1280.png) [Task page](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/days-view/) - [v/3/page.js](/framework/ai/v/3/page.js) (`days_view()` and its helpers) - [v3.css](/framework/ai/v/3/v3.css) - [v/3/readme.md](/framework/ai/v/3/readme.md). Left as a documented tradeoff, not an oversight: the row's headline comes from `day.jsonl`'s own one-line summary, not `assign.outcome`'s own bold sentence — fetching every landed task's `task.jsonl` up front (the way `ext/AITask/dashboard.js`'s `all_tasks()` already does) was measured and rejected at ~700 requests against 32; opening a row reads the real thing. `tokens` below is null - this session's own transcript file was not summed, honestly, rather than guessed.
